entities.name: Celestial Navigation (Polynesian)
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Polynesian navigators memorized the positions of 220+ stars, their rising and setting points, and seasonal variations. Combined with wave piloting and bird observation, they could navigate 2,500+ miles of open ocean.
